Toor ki qasam
Aur likhi hui kitaab ki qasam
Jo kushaada auraaq mein hai
Aur Bait-e-Ma'moor ki qasam
Aur buland chhat (aasmaan) ki qasam
Aur bhadakte hue samandar ki qasam
Yaqeenan tumhaare Rab ka azaab waaqe hone waala hai
Aur us ka koi dafa karne waala nahin hai
Jis din aasmaan baa-qaa'ida chakkar khaane lagenge
Aur pahaad baa-qaa'ida harkat mein aa jaayenge
Phir jhutlaane waalon ke liye azaab aur barbaadi hi hai
Jo mahallaat mein pade khel tamaasha kar rahe hain
Jis din inhein bharpoor tareeqe se Jahannam mein dhakel diya jaaega
Yahi woh Jahannam ki aag hai jis ki tum takzeeb kiya karte the
Aaya yeh jaadoo hai ya tumhein kuch sujhaai nahin de raha hai
Ab is mein chale jaao, phir chaahe sabr karo ya na karo sab baraabar hai. Yeh tumhaare un aamaal ki saza di ja rahi hai jo tum anjaam diya karte the
Beshak saahibaan-e-taqwa baaghaat aur ne'maton ke darmiyaan rahenge
Jo Khuda inaayat karega us mein khush-haal rahenge, aur Khuda inhein Jahannam ke azaab se mahfooz rakhega
Ab yahin aaraam se khaao piyo un aamaal ki bina par jo tum ne anjaam diye the
Woh baraabar se bichhe hue takhton par takiya lagaaye baithe honge, aur hum un ka joda kushaada-chashm hooron ko qaraar denge

Aur jo log imaan laaye aur un ki aulaad ne bhi imaan mein un ka ittibaa' kiya to hum un ki zurriyat ko bhi unhi se mila denge, aur kisi ke amal mein se zarra baraabar bhi kam nahin karenge, ke har shakhs apne aamaal ka girvi hai
Aur hum jis tarah ke meve ya gosht woh chaahenge us se badh kar un ki imdaad karenge
Woh aapas mein jaam-e-sharaab par jhagda karenge lekin wahaan koi laghwiyat aur gunaah na hoga
Aur un ke gird woh naujawaan ladke chakkar lagaate honge jo poshida aur muhtaat motiyon jaise haseen o jameel honge
Aur phir ek doosre ki taraf rukh kar ke sawaal jawaab karenge
Kahenge ke hum to apne ghar mein Khuda se bahut darte the
To Khuda ne hum par yeh ehsaan kiya aur humein Jahannam ki zehreeli hawa se bacha liya
Hum is se pehle bhi usi se duaayein kiya karte the ke woh yaqeenan bada ehsaan karne waala aur meharbaan hai
Lihaaza aap logon ko naseehat karte rahein. Khuda ke fazl se aap na kaahin hain aur na majnoon
Kya yeh log yeh kehte hain ke yeh shaa'ir hai aur hum is ke baare mein hawaadis-e-zamaana ka intezaar kar rahe hain
To aap keh dijiye ke beshak tum intezaar karo, main bhi tumhaare saath intezaar karne waalon mein hoon
Kya un ki aqlein yeh baatein bataati hain ya yeh waaqai sarkash qaum hain
Ya yeh kehte hain ke Nabi ne Quran gadh liya hai, aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh imaan laane waale nahin hain
Agar yeh apni baat mein sachche hain to yeh bhi aisa hi koi kalaam le aayein
Kya yeh baghair kisi cheez ke az-khud paida ho gaye hain ya yeh khud hi paida karne waale hain
Ya unhon ne aasmaan o zameen ko paida kar diya hai? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh yaqeen karne waale nahin hain
Ya un ke paas Parwardigar ke khazaane hain, yahi log haakim hain
Ya un ke paas koi seedhi hai jis ke zariye aasmaan ki baatein sun liya karte hain, to un ka sunne waala koi waazeh suboot le aaye
Ya Khuda ke liye ladkiyaan hain aur tumhaare liye ladke hain
Ya tum un se koi ajr-e-risaalat maangte ho ke yeh us ke bojh ke neeche dabe ja rahe hain
Ya un ke paas ghaib ka ilm hai ke yeh use likh rahe hain
Ya yeh koi makkaari karna chaahte hain, to yaad rakho ke kuffaar khud apni chaal mein phans jaane waale hain
Ya un ke liye Khuda ke ilaawa koi doosra khuda hai, jab ke Khuda un ke shirk se paak o paakeeza hai
Aur yeh agar aasmaan ke tukdon ko girta hua bhi dekh lenge to bhi kahenge yeh to teh-ba-teh baadal hain
To inhein un ke haal par chhod dijiye yahaan tak ke woh din dekh lein jis din behosh ho jaayenge
Jis din un ki koi chaal kaam na aaegi aur na koi madad karne waala hoga
Aur jin logon ne zulm kiya hai un ke liye is ke ilaawa bhi azaab hai, lekin un ki aksariyat is se be-khabar hai
Aap apne Parwardigar ke hukm ke liye sabr karein, aap hamaari nigaah ke saamne hain, aur hamesha qiyaam karte waqt apne Parwardigar ki tasbeeh karte rahein
Aur raat ke ek hisse mein aur sitaaron ke ghuroob hone ke baad bhi tasbeeh-e-Parwardigar karte rahein
